The KeepAlive scheduling, handleInit negotiation and both tagged units are unchanged, so the judgement below stands. Re-judged 2026-10-14 after TestRFC5036KeepalivesSentPeriodically changed. Positive: runSession to operational with both sides at 1s and an empty LIB; each of the next three PDUs must be a KeepAlive and each gap at most 1s; the test peer now writes a KeepAlive after each one so ze's 1s KeepAlive Timer is fed, which removes no assertion. Negative (dual-tagged with RFC5036-3.5.4.1-1, unit unchanged): TestRFC5036KeepalivePacingFollowsNegotiatedTime has ze propose 60s and the peer 1s, then requires each of the next three PDUs within 1s of the previous; it does not check their type, which the row allows (any LDP message will do), and a sender pacing from the 60s proposal fails it because the session ends after the 1s timer and the next read fails. Row-quality: the first sentence duplicates RFC5036-3.5.4.1-1 verbatim.
